{"id":18,"title":"Break work down in the Shortcut Way","state":"To Do","story_type":"chore","team":"Walid Hl's Team","owners":[],"requester":"walidhl","due_date":"2026-08-21T04:00:00Z","description":"![stories.png](https://static.shortcut.com/images/onboarding/stories.png)

### 🎟️ Stories represent a shippable scope of customer value
- Capture the problem that needs solving, and specify requirements
- Features, Bugs, and Chores are all types of Stories

### ✔️ Sub-tasks capture the implementation steps of Stories
- Aim to break down a Story into Sub-tasks that can be completed in a few days
- Sub-tasks should enable parallel work when possible and minimize dependencies

### 🏁 Epics are groups of related Stories that deliver a larger outcome
- Keep Epics scoped to deliver value within a timeframe (a week, month, quarter)
- Include clear success criteria and measurable objectives to learn from what you ship
---

### 💡 Separate business value from the implementation work
Stories and Epics should capture _what_ we want to accomplish, where Sub-tasks should capture _how_ it is accomplished.

---","tasks":[],"comments":[],"story_links":[]}

{"id":19,"title":"Automate with GitHub or GitLab","state":"Done","story_type":"chore","team":"Walid Hl's Team","owners":[],"requester":"walidhl","due_date":null,"description":"![automate.png](https://static.shortcut.com/images/onboarding/automate.png)
## Automatically connect pull/merge requests to your Stories
- Link Stories and Sub-tasks to [pull/merge requests, branches, and commits](https://help.shortcut.com/hc/en-us/articles/207540323-Using-Branches-and-Pull-Requests-with-the-Shortcut-VCS-Integrations)
- Use [event handlers](https://help.shortcut.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023113952-Setting-up-VCS-Event-Handlers-in-Shortcut) to automatically update status when PRs are created or moved into review, or merged automating transitions and reducing manual work
- Connect multiple repos

### [→ Connect GitHub](https://app.shortcut.com/agentworks/settings/integrations/github), [GitLab](https://app.shortcut.com/agentworks/settings/integrations/gitlab), or [Bitbucket](https://app.shortcut.com/agentworks/settings/integrations/bitbucket)

---

## ⛭ Suggested Setup
**1. Connect Github, Gitlab, or Bitbucket**
- Authorize your tool and select the repositories to connect

**2. Configure Event Handlers**
- Go to Settings → VCS Event Handlers
- Map events (_commit push_, _PR merged_, etc.) to workflow states in Shortcut

**3. Attach commits and branches to Stories**
- Open the **Git Helpers** menu in the Story to quickly copy valid commit messages or branch names
- Include the Shortcut Story ID in your commit message (e.g. `SC-1234: fix login bug`), or name your branch (e.g. `user/sc-1234/fix-login-bug`)


### ▶️ [Check out the video walk-through](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rqqFdFutCZ0&embeds_referring_euri=https%3A%2F%2Fchatgpt.com%2F)
